questions.q: What problem does a real enterprise run into when on-prem AD, Entra ID, and AWS each keep their own separate identity store?
options: Nothing meaningful — three directories are just three independent conveniences
Offboarding gaps, inconsistent MFA, and duplicate accounts, because no single system knows the full picture of who should have access
AWS automatically deletes any IAM user that isn't also in Active Directory
Entra ID refuses to function unless AWS IAM is disabled entirely
questions.explain: Three separate directories mean three separate lifecycle processes — most dangerously, an account disabled in one store (like AD) can keep working in another (like AWS) because nothing told it the person left.

questions.q: What does Microsoft Entra Connect actually do?
options: Syncs on-prem Active Directory users and groups into Entra ID, creating one hybrid identity instead of two separate ones
Replaces Active Directory entirely, deleting the on-prem domain controller
Issues AWS IAM access keys directly from an on-prem server
Only works if the organization has no cloud resources at all
questions.explain: Entra Connect is the sync agent that mirrors on-prem AD objects into Entra ID on a schedule, so Azure/Microsoft 365-facing resources can authenticate against the same identity as the on-prem account.

questions.q: What's the difference between Password Hash Sync (PHS) and Pass-through Authentication (PTA) in Entra Connect?
options: PHS requires a third-party MFA vendor; PTA does not
PTA only works for AWS; PHS only works for Azure
They are two names for the exact same mechanism with no functional difference
PHS lets Entra ID validate sign-ins independently using a synced hash; PTA forwards the sign-in to an on-prem agent so the password never leaves the network
questions.explain: PHS syncs a hash of the password hash so Entra ID can authenticate on its own, even if on-prem is unreachable. PTA keeps password validation strictly on-prem via a lightweight agent.

questions.q: Why is AWS IAM Identity Center the right way to extend identity into AWS, rather than giving AWS its own synced copy of Active Directory?
options: AWS IAM Identity Center cannot be federated with any identity provider
It requires every AWS user to also have a Microsoft 365 license
It acts as a SAML service provider trusting Entra ID as the identity provider, so AWS consumes an existing identity instead of becoming a fourth separate directory
It only supports federation with Google Workspace, not Entra ID
questions.explain: IAM Identity Center is built to federate with an external IdP like Entra ID via SAML 2.0, using Microsoft's prebuilt gallery app — avoiding a separate AWS-only identity store.

questions.q: What role does SCIM play once Entra ID is federated into AWS IAM Identity Center?
options: It encrypts SAML assertions in transit
It automatically provisions and deprovisions users/groups into IAM Identity Center as Entra ID's own records change
It is the protocol AWS uses to issue temporary STS credentials
It replaces Entra Connect for syncing on-prem AD
questions.explain: SCIM is the provisioning protocol Entra ID uses to push user and group changes to IAM Identity Center's SCIM endpoint, keeping the AWS side in sync with Entra ID without manual console work.
